# α3.13e — M3 review repairs

## What is new

Strict saves cross-check hearth ownership and pending idea recipients. Food, fuel and maintenance choices match characteristics, including renamed materials. Fire choices use personal evidence and uncertainty; learners decide whether to accept teaching and record their reply. Craft, tending and warming choices keep the winning reason and two actual rejected options, shown in Details and saved history. Format 6 refuses older saves without conversion.

## What to try

Start Discovery camp; pause to read a person's Details. Follow a craft or fire choice into History and compare its recorded alternatives. Follow a flake through maker/source/input and Back. Inspect cooked food, teaching replies and an idea's later attempt after reopening. Try large text, mute and rotation. The labelled First flake example is for inspection, not a frequency gate.

These repairs are source commits, not a new exported APK. [Existing pre-review check APK 41305](../build/apk-check/kindling-41305-check.apk) is 27.930 MiB and does not contain them. The existing release remains unchanged; the owner stopped builder packaging and assigned the routine to the coordinator.

## What is rough

Existing check APK: Not release-signed: built in check mode; release signing waits for the owner's passphrase. The coordinator signs releases; the check key cannot update the installed release.

Current owner disposition, failed acceptance, storage measurements and owed evidence live in [M3 result](../IMPLEMENTATION.md#m3-result); [M3 Checks](M3-CHECKS.md) retains technical validation. No acceptance number or T value changed. Winter health and full-scale worlds remain later scope.
